notes.subject: u tɛ bɛɛ taabolo
notes.rationale: Hebrew verb 'hang limp' rendered with a supplementary clause to carry the picture of legs that cannot carry

notes.subject: דליו/מפסח
notes.rationale: image chain: limp legs — proverb in a fool's mouth; the simile's second half has no verb, forcing every translator to supply one

notes.subject: דליו
notes.rationale: ASV/JPS 'hang limp' vs KJV 'are not equal'; the verb דלה/דלל means to be slack, to droop

translation: Dantigɛlen ka senw bɛ datugu, u tɛ bɛɛ taabolo; kofɛ fana nɔnmɔgɔw ka da kɔnɔ, o bɛ nin o ye.
